detail.message: another tab of this origin holds the cortex database "cortex" (single-writer claim via web-locks). Close it, or pass `onSecondTab: 'allow'` to open a second database alongside it — the two will not share rows.

note: One profile, one origin, two browser contexts: the default one and one created with Target.createBrowserContext (which a page-level session is refused: "Not allowed", measured before this file was written). Timings are not recorded because nothing here depends on them. The private context is disposed before check 8, so "forgotten" is a reading about the browser and not about the product: the product stores what the platform gives it.
